issues.explanation: Ep1 has Maya refer to her mother dying eight years ago as if it were her birth mother. Ep4 reveals Grace found her alone at age four and raised her, so Maya's origin is changed. Both can be true if Grace is an adoptive mother who died eight years ago, so this is not clearly a contradiction.
issues.suggested_fix: Optionally add a line clarifying that Grace adopted Maya and has since died.
